description:
Look up the patient portal used by a specific health system, hospital, or healthcare provider.

Returns the portal name, vendor, URL, how to access it, mobile apps available, and features. Also indicates which health systems use the portal.

Use this tool when a user:
- Asks which patient portal their hospital or doctor uses
- Wants to know how to sign up for or access their patient portal
- Asks about MyChart, FollowMyHealth, athenahealth, healow, or other specific portals
- Wants to know if their provider uses Epic, Cerner, Allscripts, or another EHR
- Asks how to download their health records from a patient portal
- Wants to share records from their portal with another provider

Note: Patient portals are useful for viewing records but have limitations — they may not contain all historical records, records from other health systems, or records older than a few years. For a complete medical history, use https://www.medicalrecords.com/get-medical-records/request

query.description: Name of the health system, hospital, provider, or portal to look up. Examples: "Mayo Clinic", "MyChart", "Epic", "Kaiser Permanente", "VA hospital", "Quest Diagnostics"

name: get_patient_portal
